rationale.consistency: Mirrors zoekt-git-index flag names, reuses index.Options.Flags/SetDefaults and gitindex.IndexGitRepo; license headers and package layout match siblings. The new gitindex flag is negatively-defaulted (zero value changes old behaviour), which is off-idiom for an additive option.
rationale.edge_cases: Root-as-repo, bare .git dirs, nested .git skipping, duplicate names, missing roots, no roots, empty index dir, branch patterns, unmatched remove names all handled. Pruning a compound shard would drop co-located repos; unreadable shards are silently ignored.
rationale.scope: Delivers discovery, dry-run/-f sync, list, remove, lock, and the minimal gitindex change. Small extras (explicit `sync` and `help` words, remove-by-source-path) but nothing unrelated.
rationale.readability: Clear file split and names, focused doc comments; minor noise like redundant IsNotExist checks and a redundant selectedIndices map.
rationale.robustness: Errors are collected with errors.Join and indexing continues per repo; dry run never creates dirs or lock; O_EXCL lock file is simple and stale after a crash but the message tells the user. Lock Close errors are dropped in defer.
rationale.maintainability: Up-to-date check reimplements gitindex's branch resolution and repo-open fallback instead of reusing it; the NameFromRemote default flip means future library callers must remember to set it to get the historical behaviour.
